question: What claim is being made about who transmitted the teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters?
premises: A teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by the earth-mover to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by the earth-mover, O beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not given in this verse.
plain_english: The teaching of the earth-moving good-eaters was told by the earth-mover, O beloved one.
